title: A Novel Boron Oxide Organic Open‐Framework Compound: B<sub>6</sub>O<sub>9</sub>(en)<sub>2</sub>@(H<sub>2</sub>en)Cl<sub>2</sub>
abstract: AbstractA new boron oxide organic open‐framework compound with (H2en)Cl2 as a template was synthesized solvothermally and characterized by various techniques such as elemental analysis, IR spectroscopy, X‐ray diffraction, thermogravimetric analysis, and luminescence. The framework is built up from neutral [B6O9] layers linked by ethylenediamine molecules through coordinative B–N bonds.(© Wiley‐VCH Verlag GmbH & Co. KGaA, 69451 Weinheim, Germany, 2009)
